items.title: Ametria Dock interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 4, 2019

ctx.x: So that concept of doing things on the fly was sort of built into you.

Yeah. From early childhood like they had a guest speaker come in. My nickname is Mimi, and so my dad would say, “Mimi come on down.” You know there was no prep. You know. So I’ve been making lists of my favorite songs since I was a kid. And that was helpful for me. I did it because I loved to do it, just to have, so I call it a “set list.” I’ve been making set lists for myself since I was a kid, because I was always put on the spot. And you know, I’m sure anyone wants to just be prepared or ready and so I would…
Would you have to sing it in the key that they were going to play it in, or did you get to like suggest?
